$meta.comment: Canonical Figma <-> code mapping (ADR-0010). Human-readable view: Architecture.md §3.1. Every entry's code file must carry `// figma: node-id=<nodeId>` in its header. Components are added here in the same PR that creates them (Phase 2+); nodeId values are looked up in Figma dev mode or via MCP at build time.
$meta.status: pre-Phase-2: paths reserved, nodeId filled in when each component is built

Atom/Tag.notes: Figma 'Color' axis → semantic CVA variant: Grey→neutral, Red→urgent, Yellow→medium, Blue→mid, Green→low (matches card priority enum)

Checkbox.notes: Checked=No/Yes prop; fetched node has no 'delete' state — needs triage before a future ticket adds it (#16)

Icon/*.notes: single wrapper around lucide-react@1.25.0+ (upgraded 2026-07-20 for the Broccoli icon, added upstream between v1.14–1.15). Figma layer names renamed 2026-07-20 to match lucide export names directly (Loading→Loader, Sort→Arrow-up-down, Dots→Ellipsis, Trashcan→Trash, Basket→Shopping-basket) — future icons should follow this convention so the mapping is a direct lookup. Exceptions (verified against rendered SVG, not name): Close/Open-sidebar have no single-word lucide match (use PanelLeftClose/PanelLeftOpen); Cross is a false friend (lucide's literal 'Cross' export is a medical/plus glyph — the real match is X); Calandar keeps its Figma typo (code corrects to Calendar).

Dropdown.notes: added 2026-07-20 (was missing from initial map); props: Field, Title, Step, Leading-icon, Trekking-icon (= trailing)

Button/Toggle.notes: added 2026-07-20 (was missing from initial map); props: Text, With text, With icon
